problems.original_quote: Crucially, however, the question of whether the identity of reviewers affects this relationship remains
problems.revised_quote: However, to the best of our knowledge, whether reviewer identity affects this relationship remains
problems.explanation: The emphasis word "Crucially", which marked the gap as especially important, was dropped.

parsed.summary: The revision removes filler and tightens the wording. Every claim, hedge ("to the best of our knowledge", "somewhat underexplored", "should consider"), number, and citation stays attached to the same statement at the same strength. The only change is the dropped emphasis word "Crucially".
